name: LotGenealogyTracer
tagline: Trace any lot forward and backward, see the recall scope and put unshipped product on hold in one place.
description: A traceability control for Power Apps and Power Pages. Search a lot, serial or supplier lot, trace it upstream to supplier lots and downstream to finished goods, shipments and customers, roll up the recall scope (shipped vs on-hand quantities), export it to CSV, and place quality holds that propagate to unshipped downstream lots. Holds are saved to the record.
features: Backward / forward / both-direction tracing with depth limit
Genealogy graph with consumption quantities and keyboard navigation
Expandable tree view, default on phones
Recall scope: affected lots, shipments, customers, supplier lots, shipped vs on-hand quantity
CSV export of the recall list
Quality holds with reason codes, validation and downstream propagation, saved to the bound column
Empty, loading, invalid, not-found and read-only states
